turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapki KYC update ke baare mein baat kar raha hu.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Haan ji, mujhe home loan Edge se related documents chahiye the.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Theek hai, aap VPA Advantage check karke bata dijiye.

turns.speaker: CUS

turns.speaker: AGT
